text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi tham gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi.
Bas aankhon ki bhasha mein hota raha sab kuch,
Aur yeh adhura ishq yun hi mukammal ho gaya.
title: Unkahe Alfaaz
description: A soft and heartfelt social media post about silent love that was never spoken out loud.
